in_hebrew.name: Emmer
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Strong, powerful one
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Emmer הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old High German words ‘amal’ meaning ‘work’ and ‘mann’ meaning ‘man’. The name Emmer can be translated to ‘strong man’ or ‘powerful one’.

in_greek.name: Emmer
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Strong, powerful one
in_greek.long_meaning: Emmer είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old High German words ‘amal’ meaning ‘work’ and ‘mann’ meaning ‘man’. The name Emmer can be translated to ‘strong man’ or ‘powerful one’.

in_latin.name: Emmer
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Strong, powerful one
in_latin.long_meaning: Emmer est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old High German words ‘amal’ meaning ‘work’ and ‘mann’ meaning ‘man’. The name Emmer can be translated to ‘strong man’ or ‘powerful one’.
